plainText:
Shun Horie (Japanese: 堀江 瞬 Horie Shun) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Horie was born in Osaka Prefecture, Japan on May 25, 1993, and became a voice actor as an adult. Horie joined the during , voicing Amethio from the Explorers.
